silvretta-montafon-overnight-gateway.title: Silvretta · Montafon Overnight Gateway
silvretta-montafon-overnight-gateway.slogan: Two passes and 303 km, high point 2032 m
silvretta-montafon-overnight-gateway.story: Toll road drama and Austrian high-country rhythm. A 303 km loop that starts and ends near Sargans, about 5 h 49 of riding. On the way it passes Bludenz and Montafon overnight. The climbs: Arlberg  option and Silvretta High Alpine Road. It tops out at 2,032 m. Arlberg Pass and Bielerhohe are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Switzerland into Austria - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The passes are the reason to go.

waypoints.advice: 1793 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 1205 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 9 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Silvretta High Alpine Road, climbing 239 m.

waypoints.name: Silvretta High Alpine Road
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 2032 m up. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Montafon overnight base, mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.title: Silvretta High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2032 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.

places-fuente-del-sabuco-ii-canada-de-la.story: From Nerpio it runs 192 km to Nerpio; allow about 3 h 19 of riding. It goes by way of Abrigo de la Viñuela, Letreros de los mártires, Cañada de la Cruz and back through Letreros de los mártires. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
